Chapter Twenty-Nine: The Promise That Remained After Goodbye

Some dreams are so beautiful that, even after waking, a person wishes they could return to them. And some dreams are so frightening that they leave behind a fear no amount of waking can immediately erase.

For Çağrı Baylan, that night would become the beginning of a nightmare he would never forget.

The Night Everything Changed

After dropping Aaliya at her apartment, Çağrı returned home. It had been a long day. The picnic, their laughter, the photographs, and the beautiful memories they had created together had left him exhausted.

He changed his clothes, placed his phone beside his bed, and lay down.

His mind wandered briefly towards Aaliya.

He remembered her smile, the way she laughed at his jokes, and how happy she had looked during their outing.

A faint smile appeared on his face.

Within minutes, he fell asleep.

But that night, his mind carried him into a dream that felt more real than anything he had ever experienced.

A Dream of a Future Together

In his dream, Çağrı found himself standing in a beautiful place with Aaliya.

The atmosphere was peaceful. There was no noise, no disturbance, and no sadness. Only the two of them, surrounded by a beautiful landscape.

Aaliya stood before him, smiling.

"Çağrı, do you remember all those beautiful moments we've captured together?"

He smiled.

"Of course I do. How could I forget?"

She looked at him affectionately.

"We've come so far, haven't we? We've shared so many memories. We spent months building our friendship, learning about each other, understanding each other's personalities, and slowly becoming a part of one another's lives. And then, somewhere along the way, our friendship became something more."

Çağrı listened quietly.

Aaliya continued, her voice filled with warmth.

"I'm proud of us. You know, sometimes I used to think that every person in this world would eventually disappoint me. I had almost stopped believing that someone could genuinely care about me."

She paused and looked into his eyes.

"But you changed something inside me. You made me realize that not every person is the same. Not every man is like the one whose actions made my childhood so difficult."

Çağrı gently held her hand.

Aaliya smiled.

"I want to spend my life with you. I want to build a home with you, share my dreams with you, and tell my family that I've found someone with whom I want to spend the rest of my life."

He looked at her, visibly emotional.

"And I want all of that too, Aaliya."

She continued speaking, almost as though she had imagined this conversation many times.

"I want us to follow our dreams. I want us to travel, explore new places, work hard, and create a life that belongs to us. I want to begin a new chapter with you, somewhere we can both feel happy and peaceful."

Çağrı smiled.

"Then we'll do all of it together."

Aaliya looked away for a moment.

But suddenly, her expression changed.

Her smile slowly disappeared.

She became quiet.

Çağrı noticed immediately.

"Aaliya? What happened?"

She looked at him, her eyes filled with an unfamiliar sadness.

"Çağrı…"

"Yes? Tell me."

She lowered her gaze.

"I'm sorry. Please forgive me."

Before he could understand what she meant, she turned and began walking away.

"Aaliya?"

She didn't stop.

"Where are you going? Aaliya, wait!"

He began following her.

But as he moved forward, the surroundings changed.

He found himself standing in a beautiful garden. Flowers covered the pathways, and the entire place seemed peaceful.

Yet there was no one there.

No Aaliya.

He looked around desperately.

"Aaliya!"

He called her name again.

"AALIYA!"

But there was no answer.

He searched through the garden, looking in every direction.

She was nowhere to be found.

And then—

The Nightmare

Çağrı suddenly opened his eyes.

He sat upright in bed, breathing heavily.

His entire body was covered in sweat.

For a few seconds, he couldn't understand where he was. His eyes moved around the room, searching for the beautiful garden from his dream.

Then reality slowly returned.

He was home.

Alone.

He reached for his phone.

And that was when he noticed something unusual.

There were numerous missed calls and messages from Aliza.

His expression changed immediately.

He opened the messages.

Çağrı, please call me.

It's urgent.

Aaliya is in the hospital.

Please come as soon as possible.

His heart seemed to drop.

He immediately called Aliza.

She answered almost instantly.

"Çağrı!"

"What happened? Why is Aaliya in the hospital?"

Her voice was trembling.

"She became very unwell during the night. We brought her to the hospital. Her condition isn't good. Please come quickly."

Çağrı stood up immediately.

"Which hospital?"

Aliza told him.

"I'm coming. Please stay with her."

He ended the call, grabbed his keys, and rushed outside.

His mind was filled with questions.

What happened to her?

Why didn't anyone tell me earlier?

Was she alright when I dropped her home?

But above all, one thought kept returning.

The dream.

Aaliya walking away.

Her final words.

I'm sorry. Please forgive me.

He tried to push the thought aside.

"No. Nothing is going to happen to her."

He started the car and drove towards the hospital as quickly as he safely could.

The Hospital

When Çağrı reached the hospital, he barely waited before making his way inside.

He found Aliza near the corridor.

"Aliza! Where is she?"

Aliza turned towards him, her eyes filled with tears.

"She's inside."

"What happened to her?"

"I don't know exactly. She became extremely unwell. We brought her here as soon as we could."

Çağrı looked through the hospital room's glass panel.

And then he saw her.

Aaliya.

But the girl lying on that hospital bed looked different from the Aaliya he had left at her apartment.

Her face was unusually pale. The brightness that he had grown accustomed to seeing in her eyes seemed almost absent. She looked terribly weak.

For a moment, Çağrı couldn't move.

His eyes filled with tears.

He had seen her laughing only the previous day. He had taken photographs with her, planned future outings, and promised to create countless more memories.

How could everything have changed so suddenly?

He turned towards Aliza.

"Why does she look like this? What happened to her?"

Aliza couldn't answer properly.

Çağrı immediately approached the doctor.

"Doctor, please tell me what's happening. Why is her condition like this? Why has she become so pale?"

The doctor looked at him seriously.

"Are you a family member?"

"I'm someone very close to her. Please, I need to know what's happening."

The doctor paused before speaking.

"Her condition is critical. She has been under considerable emotional and physical strain. Her health has deteriorated significantly, and her heart is severely weakened. We are doing everything possible, but I need you to understand that the situation is very serious."

Çağrı stared at him.

"Her heart?"

"Yes. Her condition is extremely fragile. We cannot make promises about the outcome."

Çağrı's eyes filled with tears.

"Please, doctor. She's so young. She's a doctor herself. She has so many dreams. She cannot leave like this."

The doctor placed a reassuring hand on his shoulder.

"We understand. Please give us some time."

But Çağrı could barely hear anything anymore.

The words seemed to echo inside his mind.

Her condition is critical.

Her heart is severely weakened.

We cannot make promises.

He stepped away, trying to control his emotions.

For the first time in a long while, the man who was accustomed to standing confidently before cameras and crowds felt completely helpless.

The Promise

After some time, Çağrı was allowed to see Aaliya.

He entered the room slowly.

She was lying quietly on the bed.

He approached her, trying to hide the tears in his eyes.

"Aaliya…"

She turned her face slightly towards him.

A faint smile appeared on her lips.

"Çağrı…"

He sat beside her.

"How are you feeling?"

"I'm alright."

He looked at her for a moment.

"Please don't say that. Just get better, okay? We'll go out again. Remember the picnic? We still have so many places to visit."

Aaliya looked at him.

He tried to smile.

"I'll take you wherever you want. We'll make more memories. We'll take more photographs. Just get better."

She listened quietly.

Çağrı stood up after a moment.

"I'll bring you something to eat. You should have something."

He tried to compose himself.

He didn't want her to see how frightened he was. He didn't want to break down in front of her.

But just as he began walking away, Aaliya reached out and caught his hand.

"Çağrı… wait."

He immediately turned around.

"Yes, Aaliya?"

"Stay for a minute."

He returned to her bedside.

She held his hand gently.

"I want you to promise me something."

Çağrı frowned.

"What promise?"

She looked directly into his eyes.

"First, listen to me."

He shook his head.

"Aaliya, please. Don't talk like this. You're going to get better."

But she insisted.

"Çağrı, please. Just listen."

He fell silent.

Aaliya took a slow breath.

"If something happens to me…"

"No."

"Please let me finish."

He looked at her, struggling to control his emotions.

She continued.

"If something happens to me, I want you to promise that you will continue living your life."

Çağrı's eyes became wet.

"Aaliya…"

"You will follow your dreams. You will achieve everything you've ever wanted. You will make your name known. You will never give up on your future because of me."

He shook his head.

"Nothing is going to happen to you. Do you understand? You're going to get better, and we're going to live the life we talked about."

Aaliya gently squeezed his hand.

"Çağrı, I know you want to believe that. And I want to believe it too. But I need you to make this promise."

He looked away, unable to hold back his tears.

She continued softly.

"Promise me that you won't stop living. Promise me that you'll fulfil your dreams. I don't want you to lose yourself."

He looked back at her.

His voice trembled.

"Please don't ask me for something like this."

"Çağrı…"

He closed his eyes for a moment.

Then, because she continued insisting, he finally gave her the answer she wanted.

"Alright. I promise."

Aaliya looked at him.

"Really?"

"Yes. But you have to promise me something too."

"What?"

"That you'll fight this. That you'll get better. Because I still have a lifetime of memories to make with you."

Aaliya gave him a faint smile.

For a moment, neither of them spoke.

Their hands remained together.

And Çağrı silently prayed that the promise he had just made would never become something he would have to fulfil.

A Glass of Milk

After spending some time beside her, Çağrı noticed that Aaliya needed rest.

He gently adjusted the blanket and looked at her.

"I'll get you something. Perhaps some milk. You haven't eaten properly."

Aaliya nodded faintly.

He gave her one last look before leaving the room.

As he walked down the corridor, he finally allowed himself to cry.

He wiped his face, trying to regain control.

He didn't want Aaliya to see him like that.

He went to get a glass of milk and carefully held it in his hand as he made his way back.

But as he approached her room, he noticed something unusual.

There was sudden movement outside.

A nurse hurried past. Aliza was standing nearby, looking distressed, and the medical staff seemed to be moving urgently.

Çağrı stopped.

His heart began beating faster.

"What happened?" he asked.

Nobody answered immediately.

He looked towards the room.

"Why is everyone rushing? What's going on?"

Aliza turned towards him.

Her eyes were filled with tears.

"Çağrı…"

He stepped closer.

"What? Tell me!"

She struggled to speak.

Then came the words that would divide his life into two parts.

"Aaliya… is no more."

The Three Words That Destroyed His World

For a moment, Çağrı couldn't understand what he had heard.

He stared at Aliza.

"What?"

Aliza began crying.

"Çağrı… I'm so sorry."

"No."

He shook his head.

"No, no. That's not possible."

The glass of milk slipped from his hand and fell to the floor.

It shattered.

The sound echoed through the corridor, but Çağrı barely noticed.

He looked towards Aaliya's room.

"No! She was talking to me. I was just with her!"

His voice broke.

"She promised me she would be alright!"

He moved towards the room, but his legs felt weak.

The man who had entered the hospital with the hope of taking Aaliya home was now standing before a reality he couldn't accept.

He began crying uncontrollably.

"AALIYA!"

His voice echoed through the hospital corridor.

"Please! Aaliya, wake up! We still have so much to do!"

He remembered the picnic.

The photographs.

The places they had planned to visit.

The future they had imagined together.

And then he remembered the promise.

You will continue living your life.

You will follow your dreams.

You will never give up on your future.

He had promised her.

But how was he supposed to think about the future when the person with whom he had imagined it was no longer there?

He stood completely broken.

The roses, the photographs, the laughter, and the promises of tomorrow—all of them had suddenly become memories.

Aaliya's story had reached an ending he had never imagined.

But the promise she had left behind was still waiting to be fulfilled.

And now, the question remains:

Will Çağrı Baylan find the strength to keep the promise he made to Aaliya? Will he continue living, follow his dreams, and make his name known, as she wanted him to?

Or will losing her change him forever?

The answer belongs to Chapter Thirty.

To be continued…

CHAPTER

Chapter Thirty: Where Dreams Meet Destiny

Some goodbyes come without warning. Some apologies remain unspoken, and some dreams are left unfinished—not because the people who dreamed them gave up, but because destiny had written a different ending.

For Çağrı Baylan, the day Aaliya left this world became the day his life changed forever.

The Final Goodbye

The hospital corridor was filled with silence and grief.

Çağrı stood there, unable to accept what had happened. Only moments earlier, he had been holding Aaliya's hand, listening to her voice and promising her that he would continue living his life.

Now, the person who had given those words meaning was gone.

When Aaliya's family arrived, the pain became even more difficult to bear.

Her mother could hardly believe that the daughter whose dreams she had protected through so many hardships would never return home. Tania and Sania were devastated. Her younger brother was too young to understand the full meaning of what had happened, but he could feel the sorrow surrounding him.

And then Nasir arrived.

He stood at a distance, looking towards his daughter's lifeless form. For years, he had failed to understand the value of the daughter who had once looked up to him with complete trust. He had watched her grow, but he had never truly understood how much she had suffered.

Now, for the first time, tears began falling from his eyes.

He moved closer, looking at Aaliya.

His voice trembled.

"Aaliya…"

But there was no answer.

He lowered his head.

"Why didn't I speak to you when I had the chance? Why didn't I ask you how you were? Why didn't I tell you that I was sorry?"

His tears continued.

"I wish I had spoken to you one last time. I wish I had apologized for everything. I wish I had told you how proud I was of you."

But regret had arrived when there was no longer anyone to receive his apology.

He had spent years allowing pride and anger to stand between himself and his daughter. Now, all he had left were memories and words that could never reach her.

Çağrı watched quietly.

He knew that Aaliya had spent much of her life waiting for the affection and understanding she deserved. And now, the apology she might once have wished to hear had come too late.

Aaliya's family eventually took her home for the final farewell.

Çağrı remained behind, unable to move for several moments.

He looked at the place where she had been and remembered the promise he had made.

Time had moved forward, but his heart was still standing in that hospital corridor.

Because time waits for no one. It does not return for unfinished conversations, forgotten apologies, or dreams that never had the chance to become reality.

And sometimes, the greatest pain is realizing that the moment to make things right has already passed.

Six Months Later

Six months had passed since Aaliya's death.

The world continued moving.

People went to work, attended gatherings, celebrated their achievements, and made new memories. Istanbul remained as beautiful as ever. The streets were busy, the cafés were full, and the city continued its ordinary rhythm.

But for Çağrı, something had changed permanently.

He had returned to his work and responsibilities, but there were moments when everything reminded him of Aaliya.

A particular place.

A familiar song.

A photograph.

A memory from their picnic.

Sometimes, he would look at his phone and almost expect to see a message from her.

But there was nothing.

One evening, he sat alone in his room.

In front of him stood Aaliya's photograph.

He looked at it for a long time.

Her familiar smile seemed to bring back everything he had tried so hard to accept.

He moved closer and sat before the photograph.

For a while, he said nothing.

Then his eyes filled with tears.

"Aaliya…"

His voice was barely audible.

"Do you know something? I never imagined that I would become so attached to someone. I had met so many people throughout my life, but I had never felt what I felt with you."

He wiped his tears, but they continued falling.

"For the first time, I loved someone so deeply. I wanted to make you happy. I wanted to see you achieve everything you had dreamed of. I wanted to stand beside you through every difficult moment and celebrate every little victory."

He looked at her photograph again.

"But I never knew that destiny had something entirely different planned for us."

He paused.

"Do you remember the promises we made? The places we wanted to visit? The memories we wanted to create? I still remember every single one of them."

His voice broke.

"I thought we had so much time."

He lowered his head and cried.

Then, after a long silence, he spoke again.

"Aaliya, I made you a promise that day. I promised you that I would continue living, follow my dreams, and make my name shine."

He looked directly at her photograph.

"And today, I promise you again: I will fulfil that promise. I will work hard, achieve my goals, and never allow the dreams we once spoke about to disappear."

He took a deep breath.

"But there is something else I want you to know."

His eyes filled with tears once more.

"I don't think I will ever be able to give another person the place you had in my heart. I don't want to search for someone else to replace you. I have made my decision not to marry. Perhaps our journey together was short, but what I felt for you will always remain a part of my life."

He gently touched the frame of her photograph.

"Maybe we couldn't meet in this world the way we had imagined. Maybe we couldn't live the life we planned together. But I will always carry the memories of you with me."

He paused, then whispered:

"Until we meet again, Aaliya."

For a long time, he remained there, looking at her photograph.

That evening, he cried for the girl he had loved, for the future they had imagined, and for all the ordinary moments they would never experience together.

A Promise Fulfilled

Days turned into months, and months into years.

Çağrı slowly returned to his professional life.

He continued working, pursuing opportunities, and achieving the goals he had once discussed with Aaliya. Whenever he reached an important milestone, he remembered the promise he had made to her.

He did not allow grief to erase his ambitions.

He continued building his career and making his name known through his work.

He never pursued another romantic relationship or married. It was a personal decision he had made while remembering Aaliya and the love they had shared.

But he continued living, just as she had asked him to.

Sometimes, he visited her photograph and spoke to her silently. He told her about his achievements, the places he had visited, and the dreams he had fulfilled.

He had kept his promise.

Yet there was one thing he could never change.

He could achieve everything he had once dreamed of, but he could not bring back the person with whom he had wanted to share it all.

Aaliya had followed her dreams with courage. She had fought through difficulties, crossed borders, become a doctor, and travelled to a country she had always wanted to explore.

She had finally found a happiness she once thought was impossible.

But destiny had not allowed her to live the future she had imagined.

And Çağrı, who had once promised to build that future with her, was left to carry their unfinished dreams alone.

Their story did not end because their love had disappeared.

It ended because life had given them a goodbye neither of them had prepared for.

Aaliya followed her dreams. Çağrı fulfilled his promise. But destiny had chosen a different ending for them.

And that is how their journey came to an end.

THE END.
